summary: Contributing a module to an existing collection requires meeting objective and subjective requirements; modules in some collections ship with every Ansible release, but you can also distribute via your own collection, roles, or shared code.
questions: What do I need to do to get my module into an existing collection?
Are there other ways to distribute a module besides contributing it upstream?

answer_card.title: Contributing a module to a collection
answer_card.answer_md: You must meet the community's objective and subjective requirements. Modules accepted into certain collections ship in every Ansible release on PyPI, but you can also create your own collection, embed the module in a Galaxy role, or share the code for local use.
